summary: Keep conflicting run rebuilds inside the bounded receipt savepoint rather than the generic final-drain queue.

replay.detail: Canonical run replay semantics are unchanged.

schema.detail: No schema or pending-work format changes.

rules.detail: Conflict-dirty run aggregates use the existing capped refold and rollback wrapper during the projection chunk. A covering tree inherits its parts' conflict diagnostics; ordinary run rebuilds remain deferred.

manual.detail: Existing explicit repair guidance remains applicable.

recovery.detail: Above-cap or failed conflict refolds retain degraded diagnostics instead of bypassing the bounded wrapper during final drain.
